--- title: "Figures Note IPP" author: "Gustave et Louis" date: "17/10/2023" output: html_document editor_options: chunk_output_type: console --- ## Packages ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Load packages packages <- c("here", "tidyverse", "data.table", "tidylog", "ggthemr", "scico", "sf", "patchwork", "readxl", "glue", "ggtext", "grDevices", "cowplot", "haven", "janitor", "ggrepel", "ggautomap", "stringi") librarian::shelf(packages, quiet = TRUE) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: package 'ggplot2' was built under R version 4.3.3 ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` Warning: package 'data.table' was built under R version 4.3.3 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} rm(packages) ``` ::: ## Set working directories ## Figure parameters ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # ggplot graphs theme ggthemr::ggthemr('pale') # figure height and width figure_width = 16/9 * 6 figure_height = figure_width*0.8 # alpha and font size alpha = 0.75 text_size = 22 # color palette # my_palette = scico(5, palette = "lajolla", begin = .2, end = .95) my_palette_ipp = c("#172D80", "#194E8A", "#1B5D74", "#19898A", "#178062") ``` ::: # Article ### Fig 1. Relation rang-rang en France et aux États-Unis ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cef_rank_comp <- fread("fig3B_cef_rank_boot.csv") |> mutate(country = "France") |> select(country, family_rank, child_rank) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` mutate: new variable 'country' (character) with one unique value and 0% NA ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stderr} ``` select: dropped 7 variables (n, coef, se, coef_mid, se_mid, …) ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} x_fr = 37 y_fr = 52 x_us = 63 y_us = 48 fig_rrc_us_fr <- cef_rank_comp %>% ggplot(aes(x = family_rank, y = child_rank)) + geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.75, color = alpha("#172D80", .75)) + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, show.legend = F, formula = y~poly(x, 3), color = alpha("#172D80", .75), alpha =.75) + # arrows for RRCs geom_curve(data = data.frame(x = c(x_fr + 0.5), xend = c(43), y = c(y_fr+1), yend = c(48.5)), aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.08, "inch"), type = "open"), curvature = -0.2, colour = alpha("#172D80", .75), linewidth = .5, angle = 90, alpha = .75) + # arrows for explaining each dot geom_curve(data = data.frame(x = 1.25, xend = 5, y = 31, yend = 28), aes(x = x, y = y, xend = xend, yend = yend), arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.08, "inch"), type = "open", ends = "first"), curvature = 0.2, colour = "gray20", linewidth = 0.5, angle = 90) + # text annotations geom_richtext(data = data.frame(x = c(5, x_fr), y = c(28, y_fr), label = c( "**Average** income rank in adulthood of
children born to parents in the **bottom 1%**.", paste0("**France**
*rank-rank correlation = 0.303*")), hjust = c(0,1)), mapping = aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, hjust = hjust), size = c(5.5, 6.75), alpha = .75, inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = NA, label.color = NA) + scale_y_continuous(lim = c(25, 75), breaks = seq(20, 100, 10), expand = c(0,0)) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, seq(20, 100, 20)), expand = c(0.01,0.01)) + scale_color_manual(values = c(my_palette_ipp[c(4,2)])) + labs(x = "**Parent** household income **rank**", y = "**Child** household income **rank**", color = NULL) + theme(legend.position = "none", text = element_text(size = text_size), axis.title.x = element_markdown(size = text_size, color = "black"), axis.title.y = element_markdown(size = text_size, color = "black"), panel.background = element_blank(), plot.background = element_blank()) ggsave("rank_rank_cef.png", height = figure_height, width = figure_width) ``` ::: ### Fig 2.
